parameters.name: AppName
parameters.description: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

parameters.name: BlockType
parameters.description:
The blocking mode. Valid values:
- blacklist: blacklist.
- whitelist: whitelist.

parameters.name: LocationList
parameters.description: The blocked regions, such as CN and AS. Separate multiple regions with commas (,).

parameters.name: ReleaseTime
parameters.description: The end time of the blocking period in UTC. If this parameter is not specified, the blocking lasts for 7 days by default.

parameters.name: StreamName
parameters.description: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.
